transcript.text: smelt burning plastic and saw a wisp of smoke from the top of the dishwasher door, the lights went off. I've switched it off at the wall. can I just try it again?

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell (or signs of overheating) can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using the appliance now, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't use it again until it has been checked by a qualified engineer.
